profile.summary: Gradute from Grantham University with a B.S. in Computer Science. Currently pursing my Masters in information Technology, Project Managment. Highly passionate about Software Engineering, with concentration in Software development.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contract

Software Engineer for multiple systems within the Operation Security Center for the United States Coast Guard. System languages vary from C# for the back end and ASP.NET and AJAX for the front end. Active secret clearance, with a military background.

positions.title: Customer Service Desk Agent
positions.description:
Contract

Government Contractor for EAS Service Desk assigned to the Dept. of Veterans Affairs providing direct support to Program office users, Contract Officers, Contract Specialist, and Vendors during the entire VA Acquisition Life. 
Assisted users with Database entry, Content System support, Trouble Shoot system related issue, Report, Track and escalate all issues, monitored network availability nationwide. Specializes in assisting users with eCMS and all integrated systems common to the Dept. of VA to include TOMS, IFCAP, EPIC, the ARC, FAC-C. Provides customer service and technical expertise to include; training ECMS users by phone, online network, email, and occasionally in person. Collect, analyze and provide application data reports as on the Metrics from within the tracking system and generated custom reports for client, by using Word and PowerPoint for Weekly Presentation.
Handles customer problems that arise from the use EAS applications/processes and Creates processes for responding to customer inquiries, and Records all customer service support in Namura and USD Tracking Software
Troubleshoot errors and take prompt, appropriate action on customer complaints, completes, maintains and processes pertinent paperwork and records, to include workload data. Assists in training new or Junior CSRs on the use of new applications/processes as released by development team. Assisted in the development of program training manuals, work instructions, reference library, multimedia visual aids, and other educational materials as SharePoint Admin

Other duties as assigned.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced the IGDMT dashboard application to include dynamic data visualization to include Google Maps
Wrote custom jobs incorporating the NEO4J database and Java to pull IP Address from a geo-locating services and write into the IGDMT
Worked with implementing the Arin Data Mining tool to access the Arin network and store local NAICS code within a DB mongo database

positions.title: Web Designer

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
Provided phone support, desk-side technical support, bench-top diagnosis and repair.
 Resolved customer related software and hardware problems diagnosing with problems in response to customer reported incidents.  
Assisted users with their questions about any of software and computing platforms in a professional and courteous manner. Configured devices and software applications following established procedures open and close any existing trouble tickets. 
Troubleshot and resolved end-user issues related to government applications.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Technician for a copier repair service, troubleshot copier and network problem to get the equipment running in a manner to fit their needs. Developed personal relations with customers and answered any and all questions to the best of my knowledge, to meet their needs. Filed daily logs after each job was completed, maintained records of incomplete jobs waiting for parts.

positions.title: Rival Communications
positions.description: for Circuit City. Sold, Installed and trained customers on purchased electronics. Installed TV's surround sound systems, laptops; commercial based satellites and or routers for home networks. Then I would train the customer in their home on proper use and care of equipment. Provided technical customer support over the phone in applicable situations.

positions.title: Corporal
positions.description:
/ 0341 Mortar man
Infantry squad leader during operations OEF/OIF
Awarded Battalion honors for excellency and proficiency as 81mm gunner
As Weapons Company  armory NCO I maintained and kept accountability of companies weapons
As MCBH NCO of pass house security I performed back-ground checks to ensure proper personnel were allowed on base. 
Honorably discharged from active duty service
